nodes.name: Batch Input
nodes.notes: One execution per batch of Discover Storeleads Companies. Exactly what the parent's Pull Batch passes: the query, the provider, the cursor, the client's base and record id, the page budget, what is left of the cap, the Tag. The table is not passed: the helper resolves Companies in the base itself.

nodes.name: Insert Domains
nodes.notes: The shared landing helper, the same one the parent preflighted and the same one Discover Discolike Companies uses: column check, DNC dropped, Clean Fields, upsert on Domain in tens (a held company is refreshed with the new pull, Domain Source kept, Tag re-stamped), counters back. It writes no Hub row; Batch Summary hands its numbers to the parent loop.
